title: CLIP-Powered Domain Generalization and Domain Adaptation: A Comprehensive Survey
abstract: arXiv:2504.14280v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As machine learning evolves, domain generalization (DG) and domain adaptation (DA) have become crucial for improving model robustness across diverse environments. Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) plays a central role in these tasks, offering strong zero-shot capabilities that allow models to operate effectively in unseen domains. Yet, despite CLIP's growing influence, no comprehensive survey has systematically examined its applications in DG and DA, underscoring the need for this review. translated_title: 基于CLIP的领域泛化与领域自适应：全面综述
translated_abstract: 随着机器学习的发展，领域泛化（DG）和领域自适应（DA）已成为提升模型在多样化环境中鲁棒性的关键技术。对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）在这些任务中发挥着核心作用，其强大的零样本能力使模型能够在未见过的领域中有效运行。然而，尽管CLIP的影响力日益增长，目前尚无系统性综述全面考察其在DG和DA中的应用，这正是本综述的必要性所在。本综述对CLIP驱动的DG和DA进行了统一而深入的概述。在回顾方法之前，我们建立了精确而完整的场景定义，涵盖源数据可访问性（SA vs. SF）、源域数量（SS vs. MS）和标签关系（CS、PS、OS、OPS），形成了一个连贯的分类体系，为后续所有分析提供结构框架。对于DG，我们将方法分为提示优化技术（用于增强任务对齐）等类别。
tldr: 本综述首次系统性地梳理了CLIP在领域泛化与领域自适应中的应用，并建立了涵盖源数据可访问性、源域数量和标签关系的统一分类体系。
en_tdlr: This survey is the first to systematically examine CLIP's applications in domain generalization and domain adaptation, establishing a unified taxonomy covering source accessibility, source number, and label relations.
